en.summary: Path of Exile 2 is a released Role-playing (RPG), Hack and slash/Beat 'em up game for PC, PS5, Xbox Series, developed by Grinding Gear Games and published by GGG. It is available now.

guideSections.title: Platforms & release status
guideSections.description: Path of Exile 2 is confirmed for PC, PS5, Xbox Series. The game has already launched, so platform availability is confirmed. Check the official links below for the latest word directly from the developer.
